title: 'Ganesh: Dust to Stardust' Trailer: Ganesh Acharya's Self-Directed Biopic Arrives December 11
excerpt: The National Award-winning choreographer has written and directed a biopic of his own journey; the trailer, shared by Akshay Kumar and Ajay Devgn, precedes a December 11 theatrical release.
body:
• Ganesh Acharya has unveiled the trailer of Ganesh: Dust To Stardust, the biographical drama he wrote and directed about his own journey from struggler to one of Bollywood's most decorated choreographers.
  • The film stars Shivanshu Soni, Alok Shaw, Sukanya Kalan and Sakshi Pawaskar, and releases in theatres on December 11, 2026.
  • Akshay Kumar and Ajay Devgn shared the trailer on social media; Kumar recalled that Acharya's first choreographed song was for one of his films.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p9TvG_yBCpw

Choreographer-director Ganesh Acharya has turned the camera on himself. The trailer of Ganesh: Dust To Stardust — written and directed by Acharya, and produced by his daughter Soundarya Acharya for V2S Production & Entertainment — traces his rise from humble beginnings to one of Bollywood's most recognisable choreographers, built on struggle, sacrifice and an obsession with dance.

The biographical drama stars Shivanshu Soni, Alok Shaw, Sukanya Kalan and Sakshi Pawaskar. Screenplay and dialogues are by Digangana Suryavanshi and Acharya, with music by Junaid Kumar, lyrics by Sameer Anjaan and Acharya, cinematography by Ajay Pandey and editing by Rakesh Ram. The film releases in theatres on December 11, 2026.

Why it matters

Acharya's filmography as a choreographer is woven into modern Bollywood's memory: "Beedi Jalaile" from Omkara, "Chikni Chameli" from Agneepath, "Malhari" from Bajirao Mastani. He has two National Film Awards for Best Choreography — for "Hawan Kund" from Bhaag Milkha Bhaag and "Gori Tu Lath Maar" from Toilet: Ek Prem Katha — and previously directed films including Swami and Money Hai Toh Honey Hai. A self-directed biopic from a technician of his stature is rare: it promises the view from inside the choreographer's room, where the steps are made.

https://x.com/SumitkadeI/status/2109164099930374610

The trailer's endorsement mattered too. Akshay Kumar, who shared it on Instagram, recalled that Acharya's first song as a choreographer was for one of his films; Ajay Devgn shared it as well. When two of the industry's biggest stars amplify a trailer, it arrives pre-validated.

What's next

Ganesh: Dust To Stardust releases December 11, 2026. The question the trailer poses — and the film must answer — is whether a life spent making stars look good can hold the screen on its own.
